content.comment_body: Hello, I've recently installed [product_name] [version_no] but it continually crashes. The program loads, but when I try to create a new project, the system just shows a loading indicator and doesn't proceed. I can open an old circuit from an earlier version, but if I attempt to connect to my [product_name] [article_no], it crashes again. I'm running a 64-bit system and have tried both 64-bit and 32-bit versions, including installing both 32/64-bit Java, but the issue persists. Any advice?

Welcome to the forum. Which operating system are you using? If you have Windows, try running the setup as an administrator. On a 64-bit operating system, you should only install the 64-bit version of [product_name], not the 32-bit version.

Hi [user_name], I uninstalled everything, then reinstalled Java 64-bit along with the 64-bit update for [product_name], which went smoothly. However, I'm still facing the same problem. My operating system is Windows 10. Thanks!
Sorry, I'm unable to assist further. You might need to submit a support request.

Hello, Navigate to the folder: C:/user. There, you'll find a directory named ".[product_name][version_no]". Delete this folder and try launching [product_name] again—the software will start as if it’s a clean installation. Also, check if any popup dialogs appear on a different display. Hope this helps.

With Windows 10, I suggest installing as Administrator by right-clicking the setup file and selecting "Run as Administrator" in a new, empty directory. Administrator rights are also required to use [product_name]. Additionally, it's best to close other applications during installation.
It worked! Thank you very much!

analysis.insight_summary: The user reported ongoing crashes with [product_name] [version_no] when starting new projects or connecting to hardware. The main problem centers around software instability on Windows 10 64-bit and confusion over correct installation steps and Java versions. Community responses recommend administrative installation and resetting software configuration, indicating installation procedure and system setup play a key role.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] [version_no] to work reliably on Windows 10, support project creation, and allow hardware networking without frequent crashes.
